label: Country
allowed_values: Botswana; Eswatini; Lesotho; Malawi; Mozambique; Namibia; South Africa; Zambia; Zimbabwe
notes: Use with year as the candidate key.

label: Year
definition: Calendar year to which the expenditure share refers
notes: The panel is intentionally unbalanced because Zimbabwe is available only for 2009-2012.

label: Agriculture share of government expenditure
definition: Share of total government expenditure allocated to agriculture forestry fishing and hunting at the highest available government level
missing_values: blank represents missing and is not zero
notes: This broad policy-related exposure is not maize-specific and is not itself an intervention assignment.

label: Source flag
definition: FAOSTAT status describing the origin or treatment of the source value
notes: Retained because source status matters when interpreting the prepared panel.

label: Government level
definition: Highest government level represented by the observation
allowed_values: Budgetary Central Government; consolidated General Government
notes: Level changes can produce breaks that must be considered in analysis.
